title: The final ending epilogue (status after WIN) name-drops places and events I never encountered anywhere in 547 turns of play -- 'the Choir of Ash... above Glasswick', 'the drowned fleet still rows the fog off Gullhaven's point', 'the Farlight stands dark', 'Cinderhall's chapterhouse changed hands' -- since I never visited the Saltkerns, Iron Downs, or Hollowbrook, these read as an unearned lore-dump rather than a payoff for anything I did.
